provenance.note: Decision rule only; the vocabulary references are unchanged. Chosen on leave-one-out templates and half of the replayed unsupported clips; kept over a lower-objective setting with negative references (59 against 64) partly on held-out figures, so the held-out half is not untouched for this choice. Made the default on 2026-11-13 by the project owner's decision; ?wordGate=shipped restores the gate stored in the word model.
